{{Quote|Jaller's still stuck at HQ. Haven't seen him for two days, but that's normal for Jaller.|Telti Obrim discusses her husband, CSF Captain Jaller Obrim|<ref name="Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
'''Telti Obrim''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jaller Obrim]], the head of the [[Anti-Terrorism Unit]]. They lived with their two teenage sons in the [[Rampart Town]] section of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TC" /> 

Telti had grown used to the demands of Obrim's work as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] and took many aspects of his life in stride and was described as a pleasant woman. During [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Fi Skirata]]'s [[Standoff in the Republic Central Medcenter|rescue]] from being euthanized at the [[Republic Central Medcenter/Legends|Republic Central Medcenter]], Telti did not object when her husband brought Skirata to their [[Jaller Obrim's residence|home]] to stay indefinitely.<ref name="TC" />
